title: Emenegger and Linda Moulton Howe promised footage that is then pulled

tellings.quote: away. Then in the 70s you got Emagger and uh and uh Lyndon Molton Howler and who think they're also going to get footage then it get pulled away.

plain: In the 1970s and 80s, a filmmaker named Robert Emenegger and a journalist named Linda Moulton Howe each believed the government would give them real UFO footage, and each time it was pulled away before they got it. A guest named Bryce Zabel, talking about Hollywood and UFOs, tells this as part of a pattern of promises made and taken back. It would suggest someone in government was testing or teasing public disclosure through filmmakers.
